blurb: Guests fish for species like bonefish, tarpon, permit, snapper, grouper, sailfish, mahi, and tuna in the Florida Keys and Everglades. Trips are tailored to skill level from novice to experienced anglers. Captain Brian Helms provides all gear except for personal items like lunch and sunscreen.
extraNote: $200 per day deposit required to hold booking · Deposit minus credit card fees refunded if cancelled more than 30 days before trip · Deposit refunded if weather is unsafe as determined by captain

quotes.text: We had a fantastic day of fishing with Captain Brian of SeaYaFishing. He guided us to a fantastic spot in the Everglades National Park and helped us with our casting technique in windy conditions. We caught a lot of fish and were able to enjoy the beauty of the Florida Keys. He was very patient with us and helped us maximize our ability to have a successful day of fishing. I highly recommend Captain Brian for all fishing levels. His expertise is obvious and he is highly knowledgeable about the area and all types of fishing – fly, spin, deep sea, and spear fishing.

What an amazing time spent with Capt. Brian on the Conch 27. We had a blast catching a bunch of nice size yellow tail and learning about the fishery and of course our captain. If your looking to book a trip for either the novice or well seasoned fisherman Capt. Brian will have you covered. The giant bonus was all the meat we ended up with after Capt. Brian meticulously filleted it for us in fact the biggest bag I have ever taken home from a trip.

Spent three awesome days with Capt. Helms and my oldest son. I think we caught everything in Florida Bay- blacktip sharks, spanish mackerel, snook, redfish, seatrout, mangrove snappers, etc- even managed to have a shore lunch one day and eat our catch. Always a great time with Capt. Helms and he does an exceptional job teaching kids on how to saltwater fish! Can’t wait for my next trip with Capt. Helms!

My nephew and I fished with Brian in February for two days. I’ve fished with guides all over the world and Brian is the best! Found the fish each day and made it the trip of a lifetime for my teenage nephew! Very professional, knowledgeable and fun. Thanks Brian!

Brian and Christine, Kristen and I were absolutely amazed with our experience! From our first phone call to our last cast of the day, absolutely amazing! You guys helped me check a bucket list item and you simply nailed it! Cant wait for our return experience.

Brian did a great job of getting me on fish in really difficult conditions. He worked extremely hard to find them and we were able to convert on many fish on a day that could have easily been a bust. I will fish again with Brian when i am next in the area!
